title: Runway or an Agency for an AI Commercial: Which to Choose
summary: Runway sells AI video generation you run yourself. An agency takes on the brief, production and checks. Compare what each route delivers, costs and fits.
body_markdown:
## What do agencies charge for commercial-style work?


Agency prices for commercial-style work mostly come as subscriptions, fixed packages or quotes by scope. As of October 2026, Superside's pricing page lists a $15,000 monthly minimum on an annual term, plus a $1,000 monthly software fee, and says its flexible budget covers motion, 3D and video editing ([Superside pricing](https://www.superside.com/pricing) ). Vidico's ad creative page lists subscription plans from $5,000 a month with all creative services included ([Vidico ad creative page](https://vidico.com/services/ad-creative-production/) ).


Those are different products. A subscription buys a queue of work, while a one-off video buys one deliverable. ContentBeta, which describes itself as a creative production partner for B2B SaaS and AI companies, prices a one-off video at $2,000, and it includes a script, storyboard, product UI animation, voiceover, two revision rounds and two social or ad cuts, with a 10-day turnaround ([ContentBeta ad creative](https://www.contentbeta.com/services/ad-creative/) ). It also lists a $3,000-a-month subscription. Ask every provider for the same deliverable, with the same aspect ratios, revision rounds and usage rights, before you compare prices.


## What should you check before you hire an agency for an AI commercial?


Start with accountability. Meta's Ad Creative Generative AI Terms make the advertiser solely responsible for checking the accuracy of output from Meta's own tools ([Meta's Ad Creative Generative AI Terms](https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms/ad_creative_generative_ai_terms) ). Those terms cover Meta's tools, but the lesson carries over: a generated shot can show a product that does not exist, so someone must check every shot against your real product, and you should know who that is before you sign.


Then get four things in writing:


- **Revision rounds.** 351 Studio, for example, typically offers two revision rounds on its AI video production work, as of October 2026.
- **Turnaround.** 351 Studio states 2 to 12 business days, depending on scope.
- **Placement.** Meta's Reels ads page recommends 9:16 video with audio, with key messages in the safe zone clear of the Reels interface ([Meta's Reels ads page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/facebook-instagram-reels-ads) ). Ask for captions as well.
- **Usage rights.** Ask whether the rights cover paid and organic use, and for how long.


Our[AI commercial production guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/ai-commercial-video-production) covers the buyer checklist in more depth.


## Which route fits which team?


Runway fits a team with an in-house editor, one clear concept, a modest budget for testing and time for retakes. Each discarded take uses credits, so the team needs patience with the generation process. The team also has to own the script, continuity and final check.


An agency fits a team that needs a finished commercial on a deadline, approval from a brand owner and the same partner to run the campaign. The trade-off is that you pay for the production and the accountability, not for seconds of generated footage.


If you are unsure, buy a short test. Make one 15-second spot on each route, using the same brief and the same approval checklist, and compare the cost of the approved version. The result will show you the real price of each route better than any plan table does. Our[video agency, in-house and AI platform comparison](https://knowlify.com/articles/video-agency-vs-in-house-vs-ai-platform) sets out the same choice across all three models.


## Key takeaways


- Runway sells generation seconds. A finished AI commercial also needs scripting, continuity, editing and a full check.
- Knowlify is our top pick when you want a done-for-you team to make and check AI commercials, from $5,000 a month.
- Compare routes on finished, approved spots and revision rounds, not on the plan price.
- Someone must check every generated shot against the real product. With Runway that person is you; with an agency, confirm who it is in writing.


## FAQ


### Is Runway cheaper than hiring an agency?


Per generated second, Runway's paid plans are inexpensive. Pro lists about 187 seconds of Gen-4.5 video for $28 a month on annual billing. That is generation time, not finished spots, so count retakes, edits and review hours before you compare it with an agency quote.


### Can a small team make an AI commercial in Runway?


Yes, if one person can write the brief, generate each shot, edit the cut and check every frame. Plan for discarded takes, since each one uses credits. The check is also yours: Meta's terms put the accuracy check on the advertiser for output from Meta's own tools, and the same care applies to footage from any model.


### What should an agency deliver for an AI commercial?


Ask for the exact aspect ratios, captions, revision rounds, turnaround and usage rights in writing. As of October 2026, 351 Studio lists exports in four aspect ratios with captions and hooks, typically two revision rounds, and a 2 to 12 business day turnaround depending on scope.


### Should I test an AI commercial before I scale it?


Yes. Run it against your current best ad in your own account and judge it on the metrics you already track.[Meta's Create to Convert studies](https://www.facebook.com/business/news/4-ways-to-turn-still-image-ads-into-video-ads) compared motion with still images, not with live action, so your own test is the only proof for your product.


### Does Knowlify make creative for brands that already have a media buyer?


Yes. Knowlify offers creative-only delivery for a team that already has a buyer, alongside its end-to-end Meta management. Pricing for either option is a custom quote, and the 90-day refund guarantee has terms on the site. That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month.
